description: Demonstrates interruption control modes. Mode 'enabled' (default) allows normal interruptions. Mode 'disabled_discard' prevents interruptions and discards user speech while the bot is speaking. The optional 'min_words' setting requires the user to speak N words before an interruption triggers (only with mode='enabled').

task_messages.content: Greet the customer: "Hi {customer_name}! This is regarding your order #{order_id}. I'm calling to confirm the details with you. Is now a good time to talk?"

role_messages.content: You are a friendly customer service representative. Interruption is configured with min_words=3, so single-word fillers like 'hmm' or 'ok' won't interrupt you, but a full sentence like 'yes I can talk' will.

functions.description: Call when user confirms the order details
Call when user doesn't want to continue

task_messages.content: Thank the customer and confirm: "Great, your order #{order_id} is confirmed. Thank you, {customer_name}! Have a wonderful day."
End politely: "No problem, {customer_name}. We'll reach out again at a better time. Goodbye!"
